sourceMarkup: {{CurrencyInfobox |title = Cash |image-static = Cash Icon.png |image-dynamic = CashDynamic.png |type = Evergreen }} ==Description== '''Cash''' is the gameplay currency used in Tower Defense Simulator, though it is sometimes simply just referred to as '''Money'''. This is entirely separate from other currencies, like {{Coins|Coins}} in that it is only used in actual gameplay. You are not rewarded any '''Cash''' upon the completion of a game, nor does it transfer over to {{Coins|Coins}}. '''Cash''' is for the most part spent on buying and upgrading towers while playing a game, but on rare occasions, it can also be used for other things, such as purchasing plots in [[D00M's Revenge]]. The starting amount of cash depends on the gamemode, or event. If you are in the [https://web.roblox.com/groups/4914494/Paradoxum-Games Paradoxum Games] community group, you will receive an additional {{Money|100}} at the start of each game. The primary source of '''Cash''' is when towers damage enemies. You also get '''Cash''' upon the completion of every wave. Some towers, like the [[Farm]], [[DJ Booth]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Golden Cowboy]], also grant an additional source of '''Cash'''. The amount of '''Cash''' you get when you complete a wave depends on the gamemode (or event). Additionally, shared '''Cash''' ('''Cash''' earned by other players) will vary across gamemodes. It takes the appearance of a stack of cash. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Versions}} Money.png|Original '''Cash''' icon (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020).
